_help: EDIT ME: the open-world city. 20x20 grid. Avenues run north-south (x), streets run east-west (y). Districts are rectangles on the grid. POIs are landmarks with actions. Everything here is editable: rename streets, move landmarks, add districts, change prices and lines.

districts.name: Old Chapel Ward
districts.ambience: Calm, sacred echoes — church bells rolling over quiet stone.
flavor: Bells roll out from a stone tower and fade over the rooftops.
A rosary clicks softly somewhere out on a porch.
Candle smoke drifts across the street like a slow secret.

districts.name: Midtown Strip
districts.ambience: Music and neon — clubs breathing bass, restaurants humming.
flavor: Neon buzzes and a club door spills brass notes onto the pavement.
Laughter and glasses clink from a late kitchen.
A taxi horn argues with a saxophone. The saxophone is winning.

districts.name: Upper Hills
districts.ambience: Wealth and security — mansion gates, private patrols, trimmed hedges.
flavor: A black sedan idles behind wrought iron, engine purring.
Security lights sweep a manicured lawn.
Somewhere behind a gate, a fountain counts money in water.

districts.name: Industrial Row
districts.ambience: Metal and engines — pawn shops, car wash, garages.
flavor: A grinder sings one long note behind a garage door.
Steam hisses from the car wash like a tired animal.
Forklifts reverse in a yard that never sleeps.

districts.name: Garden Parks
districts.ambience: Breathing room — trees, basketball, stealth meetups.
flavor: Leaves turn over in a warm wind.
A chain net rattles; somebody's shooting late hoops.
Two voices stop talking when you pass. Then start again.

districts.name: Southside Blocks
districts.ambience: Danger and pressure — bass, barking dogs, watchful windows.
flavor: A chain-link fence rattles as a dog makes its opinion known.
Bass rolls under the street like slow weather.
Somebody watches from a window — then the curtain drops.

districts.name: Harborfront
districts.ambience: Ropes, gulls, diesel — speedboats and the way off the map.
flavor: Ropes creak against a mast in the dark.
Diesel knocks twice from a boat engine, then settles.
A gull argues with the night and loses.

pois.name: Stoneface's Safehouse
pois.describe: The crew's safehouse. Creaking floorboards, a wall of maps, Salena's case pinned in the center.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: Safehouse. You rest among the maps and the quiet. Health restored.

pois.name: Salena's Apartment
pois.describe: Salena's seized apartment building. Police tape still across the door. The jingle lock waits inside.

speakerLines.speaker: stoneface
speakerLines.text: Her window. Third floor. The tape says seized — the dust says waiting.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: The First Echo case begins here. Start the story from the main menu when you are ready.

pois.name: St. Verity Church
pois.describe: Old stone church. Candle smoke and low hymns. The one honest gatekeeper keeps office here.

speakerLines.speaker: priest
speakerLines.text: Sit, son. The candles don't charge. Rest, and the city will still be cruel when you step back out.

pois.name: Ledger's Pawn Shop
pois.describe: Elias Ledger's pawn shop. Bars on the windows, bargains behind them.

speakerLines.speaker: ledger
speakerLines.text: Stoneface! Windows full of trouble, shelves full of answers. The Hurricane, eight hundred. Iron Chef plate, seven hundred. Priest gates the big purchases — I just make the city feel real.

pois.name: The Velvet Room
pois.describe: Neon club. Bass you can feel through your shoes. The back office counts the block's money every night.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: The Velvet Room. Three heartbeats in the back office counting cash. In the story, this is where the stickup happens.

pois.name: Blue Note Diner
pois.describe: All-night diner. Coffee, grits, and rumors in equal measures.

action.notEnough: Not enough CC for the Focus plate. You need 40.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: Focus plate served — black coffee, cornbread, quiet booth. Health up, mind sharp. Minus forty CC.

pois.name: The Monarch Theater
pois.describe: Old movie theater. Marquee flickers. Lobby posters, and lobby whispers.

speakerLines.speaker: news
speakerLines.text: Tonight's feature: the Mayor's charity gala, live coverage. Wexler smiles for the cameras while the budget bleeds somewhere off screen.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: Lore logged. The Monarch always knows more than it shows.

pois.name: The Ironrail Court
pois.describe: Chain nets, cracked asphalt. The loudest heartbeat on the Southside, and one very quiet one courtside.

speakerLines.speaker: harbor
speakerLines.text: Free-roam, huh? The block's quieter when you walk it slow. Keep your ears honest, Stoneface.

pois.name: Southside Corner Store
pois.describe: Fry oil, citrus cleaner, a radio playing low. The owner watches weather and strangers.

action.notEnough: Not enough CC for the buffalo plate. You need 50.

speakerLines.speaker: glasses
speakerLines.text: Buffalo plate, extra hot. Grit buff granted. Minus fifty CC.

speakerLines.speaker: news
speakerLines.text: Counter talk: big quiet man still sits courtside off Ironrail. Never loses. Never talks.

pois.name: Bonnie's Garage
pois.describe: A converted warehouse. Tools, armor plating, and one very patient bulletproof SUV.

speakerLines.speaker: bonnie
speakerLines.text: Garage is home, but the street is where I make sense. Press B anytime and I'll roll up. Three blocks a breath when you ride with me.

pois.name: Marlow's Pier
pois.describe: Old Marlow's speedboat, fueled and pretending to be a fishing boat.

pois.name: Fish Market
pois.describe: Ice, crates, and rumors priced by the pound.

pois.name: Wexler's Mansion
pois.describe: The Mayor's mansion — gates, guards, and a gala that ends a city's lie.

pois.name: Tess's Workshop
pois.describe: Area Six's garage lab: armor plates, healing chamber, Bonnie's birthplace.

pois.name: Ironrail Car Wash
pois.describe: Steam, brushes, and a clean way to lose the police's eye.

pois.name: Garden Greenhouse
pois.describe: Warm glass and wet leaves — the quiet place crews meet when walls have ears.
